tool: Built-in image_gen, reference-guided transparent sprite atlases
model: The runtime does not expose a model version.
reference: Each named unit uses its original card portrait in scripts/art_library.gd CARD_ATLASES. Row-major input contact sheets contain only the listed cards. The ferryman uses the fourth portrait on the first row of afterglow-units-v1.png.
processing: tools/prepare_unit_pieces.py preserves native alpha, separates cells at clear gutters, anchors boots in 256 px standing cells and packs named pieces in the same slots as their cards. The ferryman poses share one fixed scale and use wider contact cells.

standing.prompt: Identity-preserve. Create ONE production sprite atlas for an original 2D tactical RPG. The reference is an ordered contact sheet of original portrait paintings. Translate each cell's specific subject into the exact corresponding full-body battlefield miniature in the SAME cell. 3/4 view facing right, relaxed alert stance with natural adult proportions, boots and entire weapon or whole horse visible. Clean hard-edged anime cel shading, strong dark navy outlines, broad light shapes, sparse interior details readable at 65px. Keep every individual face, age, skin tone, hairstyle, gender presentation, attire colors, weapons, horse and signature props faithful to its own portrait. Equal cell sizes on an invisible grid, all isolated, ample transparent gutters, centered on each individual cell and feet aligned near its bottom. A mounted rider and entire horse belong together. No written words or labels, card frames, borders, floor, bases, scenery, backdrop, cast shadows or common uniform. True alpha transparency. Sheet 3 columns x 2 rows, SIX cells. 依据这张由六幅原卡组成的参考图制作一张透明的日式战棋棋子图集。严格按照原图的三列两行顺序，一格一个人物，保留各自的相貌、头发、衣着色块、性别、道具、马匹。请把截断的身体补画至双脚或马蹄，所有人之间留出足够透明空隙。按顺序是紫衣持金色麦旗的军官，穿黄披肩骑浅灰马的信使，穿绿色外衣的弓手，裹白色头巾提灯的医师，穿红棕甲拿两张文书的壮年男子，最后是穿绿色长甲持红缨长枪的女子。原画风格的清晰深色外轮廓和平涂阴影，全部是成年人，朝右侧四分之三角度，适合俯视平面战场。只画六枚完整的棋子，无文字、底座、场景、阴影、边框。Transparent alpha.

ferryman.prompt: Identity-preserve reference-to-gamesprite. Make ONE transparent four-frame 2 by 2 atlas for a Japanese cel-animated tactical RPG. All four cells depict exactly the SAME older, stocky male river ferryman from the supplied original portrait, facing right in 3/4 view. Match his swept tied salt-and-pepper hair, off-white tied headband, bushy pointed grey beard and moustache, broad jaw and arms, russet rectangular copper lamellar plates over indigo boatman's tunic, grey trousers, calf wraps, dark flat boots, rope belt and red-ribboned long crescent-bladed boat hook/polearm. Full body including feet and weapon end in every cell. Flat restrained cel shading, strong deep-navy ink contour, simple high contrast silver beard when reduced to 64px. Adult non-chibi proportions. FOUR evenly spaced separate cels in square cells, empty transparent wide gutters, all boots on same baseline within each cell, similar scale. Top left: natural standing on deck, confident with hook gripped upright. Top right: low defensive brace with both hands and weapon raised. Bottom left: short advancing thrust to the RIGHT with hook, weight on front foot. Bottom right: pull back after strike, weapon diagonal, shoulders settling. Wide enough separation; no overlapping cells, no ground or shadow, no text, numbers, frames, panel lines, glow, background or other characters. Real transparent background.
